Subject: POC plan & success criteria (post-call recap)

Thanks again for taking the call today, Sarah - great to meet you and Tom. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment going into the trial: 

Summary of what we covered:
- Goal: validate that Redwood can reduce inference cost by >=30% at target latency <=150ms for the 1k QPS simulated workload, and that model outputs meet your quality bar for clinical note summaries.
- Scope: 2-week POC on Dedicated (staging) with the 7B quantized model variant.
- Success criteria (draft):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 150ms under 1k QPS synthetic load.
  - Cost: per-1k-token cost reduction >=30% vs current baseline.
  - Quality: ROUGE-L and human spot-check pass rate >= 92% on your evaluation set (see sample list).
  - Security: no PHI exfiltration; logs retained per Acme policy for 30 days.

Owners & timeline:
- Redwood: Marcus will own environment setup and traffic shaping; Rishi will lead procurement/contract handoff.
- Acme: Sarah will own evaluation and exec readout scheduling; Tom to validate infra/POC acceptance.
- Proposed timeline: provisioning week of 6/1, run evaluation 6/3-6/10, final readout week of 6/8-6/12 (flexible).

Attachments: POC-plan-acme-health.pdf, MUTUAL-ACTION-PLAN.xlsx (stubbed).

Next steps:
1) I'll send the finalized M.A.P. and schedule the provisioning call for 6/2.
2) Marcus will send the test harness details and sample dataset upload link.
3) Sarah to confirm exec readout timeframe and decision owner.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
